context.body: Human smallness under the heavens is held with bestowed dignity and responsibility.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The psalm addresses the LORD’s majestic name, recalls the heavens as divine work, and marvels that God remembers and appoints humans.
observations.label: God’s majesty and human vocation: action

observations.body: Weak human beings receive honor and rule beneath God’s rule.
observations.label: God’s majesty and human vocation: response

observations.body: majestic name · work of your fingers · mindful · crowned
observations.label: Words in Psalm 8:1–9

payload.posture: Read Psalm 8:1–9 as prayer and wisdom evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The poem does not explain why God attends to humans; it turns that surprise into praise.
payload.title: God’s majesty and human vocation
